bluf: Primelis is a Levallois-Perret martech agency founded in 2009 on organic search, now selling a full funnel growth system built on in house technology, SEO first, then AI search, data, paid search and retail media, with a US presence since 2020. It builds by product and acquisition, Occurus in 2012, Seolyzer in 2021, Cross Brand in 2022, Omny.ai in 2024, with four named products fronting its navigation. Horus reads Favored at 13; Monsoon reads Onshore wind at 56.1. What a rival should know: it names no client in the record, publishes no llms.txt while selling an AI SEO audit, and updated nothing in its sitemap in 365 days.
doing:
The positioning line, a martech agency linking brand and performance by uniting siloed channels, teams and data into one full funnel growth system powered by in house technology, decodes as an SEO agency that has turned its tooling into the product: the navigation fronts Brand OS, Signal, Market and Outrank ahead of its services. The headline claim is a growth case, a client growing online sales from $400K to $100M, with the client unnamed in the record.

The sold mix leads with SEO, score 3, the line it was founded on in 2009, with Occurus built as an in house SEO platform in 2012 and Seolyzer bought in 2021. Four core lines score 2: AI Search / GEO, on a dedicated AI SEO audit measuring citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini plus French GEO audit and GEO/GSO agency pages; Data & Measurement, with data in the navigation and meta, a homepage pitch on isolating each channel's incremental impact and Brand OS tuning the marketing mix; Paid Search, added in 2014, with Cross Brand built to cut wasted spend; and Retail Media, with Omny.ai taken in during 2024. B2B, content and PR and paid social score 1; the rest score 0. Breadth is 8. The proprietary list runs to nine names, including PSO, predictive search optimization tech; the record lists no partners.

Its AI posture is a product: the AI SEO audit and GEO/GSO offer measure brand citations, and the Horus read scores P1 as making, an audited AI visibility product, while its own site publishes no llms.txt.

The dated moves run 2020, US market entry; 2021, the Seolyzer acquisition to automate organic work; 2022, the Cross Brand launch; 2024, Omny.ai and the creative studio Cosmy joining the group.

The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for a martech agency selling a growth system: a single named client, any creator or CRM line, and any content published in 365 days.
clients:
The client type is mixed; the verticals listed are SaaS, ecommerce, retail, B2B, consumer brands, private equity and agencies; the home market is the Paris area, with a US presence since 2020 and no US city shown.

The record lists 0 clients. A case studies page sits in the evidence list, and the headline claim reports a client growing online sales from $400K to $100M, but the needs read extracted no name from either, so observed needs are 0, names only are 0, the computed mix is empty and no client is shared with another tracked agency. The evidence type table is empty: no case study name, no logo wall, no press release, no testimonial. An agency that fronts four products and nine proprietary technologies names no one who uses them, and that is the finding.

Two of the listed verticals, private equity and agencies, are buyer types rather than end markets, which reads as technology sold to owners and resellers as well as to brands; that is an inference from the vertical list, not a stated fact.

What the base needs next: the record says it is best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO with Paid Search adding, and for KJ2, ads inside AI answers, and most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, driven by SEO and Paid Search, a headwind. With no client signal at all, every need is inferred from the sold mix: it is likely, with low confidence, that a book bought on organic growth and retail media will ask for citation measurement next, which the AI SEO audit sells, and roughly even chance that the same book will move its SEO and paid hours to whoever prices on outcomes first.
